audits.method: Serial alternating-order complete audits, including maps. Both policies are warmed once. Kernel load, input loading, comparison and hashing are outside each audit timer. Only elapsed time is excluded from exact output equality.

auditModel.method: Guarded disk-centre lattice on the unfolded capsule. Four-neighbour connectivity; analytic outline and chord-distance refinement near threshold.
limitations: This replaces the Python GEOS offset implementation; numerical results are not identical.
Pass/fail concern this guarded discrete rolling-disk model, not stress or tear resistance.
Uncertain is not accepted by the strict material-core gate. Increase resolution to investigate.
Small tips and features below the explicitly stated area threshold are not certified.

audits.resultStorage: Each zero-based configuration reference selects settings for that case. Complete outputs were compared before compaction. Repeated summary fields are derivable from those settings, status and family records; model method and limitations are retained once in auditModel.

browserAudits.method: Same complete audit, including maps. Four rounds rotate policy order after one warmup for each policy and input. Loading, warmups and exact comparisons are outside audit timers. current selects the measured backend; cachedJavaScript and forcedWasm isolate backend costs with the same outline reuse.

profiles.note: Separate instrumented browser contexts wrap selected functions from workspace source to measure inclusive and exclusive time. Release flows below use the uninstrumented production build.

hunodan.criteria: Each prepare + solve + validate + export <=10 seconds; independent error <= that case’s validated release error, plus at most 1 percentage point for an identical pair; unchanged geometry, strict paper and substantial feature checks. Decode and independent external replay are timed separately.

weighted.method: Fresh automatic mask solves. Frames fixed before fitting. Checker strategy replaces the band; weighted strategy retains the original mask with zero band weights. Exported controls are independently rendered with resvg. Geometric and paper checks remain enabled. Variants swap both colours, translate by one source pixel in both axes with background fill, or alter only zero-weight pixels; the protected frame stays fixed.

browser.timingScope: The harness timer includes worker-result capture and three artifact writes before checking Draw readiness. It is not a pure app-latency measurement. The separately reported fitter timings in browserChanges exclude this bookkeeping but do not cover all export or editor conversion work.

limitations: Reuse requires exact equality of actual paper-audit inputs, after the existing cubic flattening tolerance. It does not establish exact equality of arbitrary input Bézier controls.
Fixed-audit comparisons alternate order; full image comparisons and profiles are separate runs. Whole-solve timing and fitting remain hardware-, runtime- and deadline-dependent.
Every change to a sheet is reconsidered on the next audit; no cut geometry or audit result is retained between calls by this optimization.
The guarded discrete paper model does not certify tear resistance or physical assembly.
